nodes.title: Tried (review v4 park/adopt + ship5 one-running-stage rule, as shipped to int/r6 21a): a face stage parked on unmount only stopped drawing and kept its place in the page's one-running-stage list until its park timer disposed it. Broke: the safety Help sheet mounts a second live face over the lesson's; when the sheet closed, the lesson's suspended stage stayed frozen for 1.5 s, or 10 s for a worker-backed stage (HANDOFF_PARK_MS, the default), over her voice. Now: PuppetStage.park() yields the slot at once and start() takes it back on adoption (tests/r7-audit-face.test.mjs FACE-01). Any new way to keep a stage alive off the page must yield the slot the same way.

Tried (face-home-daily-greeting): server code deciding whether a shipped file exists by looking under public/. Broke: the production image copies dist/, server/, shared/, data/ and src/ only, so the check was always false there and GET /api/tutors/greeting could never return a clip. Now: the served build (dist/, or TAXILA_DIST) is checked first, then public/ (server/face-puppet/greetings.js clipDirs). tests/runtime-image-imports.test.mjs covers imports, not file reads: any server file read outside those five folders fails silently in production.

Corrects dc-r7-face-teachback-protege ('looks from the child to the protege while she listens, speaks or waits'): she glances at the protege only while she speaks or waits for the child. While the child talks she keeps her eyes on the child (src/avatar/behaviour.ts lookAt drops any look in LISTENING and THINKING, by design), so the listening glance was requested every 3.6 s and never shown. Teacher.tsx no longer requests it. Reverse only if behaviour.ts gains a deliberate listening look.

Classes 1-3 teach-back: the prompt names the protege 'Golu, a pretend baby elephant' (server/compiler/characters/asha.js young.protege; shapes.js teachback and hook), the screen shows a cloud pup, a pebble or a sprout (src/ui/teacher/Protege.tsx). No elephant art exists. Needs Brain (species-free wording) or new art. docs/design/round7/audit/face.md FACE-03.

lamp2 (one of the owner's three look choices): its painted key sources lived only in a session scratch folder (scripts/character/puppet2d/lamp2/common.py L2_SCRATCH) and that folder no longer exists (the earlier Face session confirmed), so they are gone for good. public/face-puppet/lamp2 (22 files) is the only copy of the pack: keep it, never delete it as 'rebuildable'; changing lamp2 means painting and paying again. r8 can still be re-packed from tracked layers (pack.py and sync-runtime reproduce the shipped pack byte for byte, checked 2026-11-10) but not re-cut (polish-r8/work is untracked). face.md FACE-14.

v4-review2-r9-sync-due (2026-10-05) recorded puppet polish r9 judged 4.2 vs r8 4.1 with its sync to production due; production still ships r8 and no decision or rejection covers r9 or r10 (art/character/puppet2d/polish-r9, polish-r10, 42 MB). Decide: sync, or record why not. face.md FACE-16. Owner decision 2026-11-10: the r9 sync is deferred to the owner's look pick (r8, lamp2 or r9); r9 and r10 art and scripts are kept until then.

Deleted as repository weight, nothing reads them (importers, package.json, CI, Dockerfiles, tests, context citations checked; r8 re-pack proved unchanged after): art/character/puppet2d/polish-r3..polish-r7 and scripts/character/puppet2d/polish-r3..polish-r7 and judge-r1..judge-r7-blind.mjs; art/character/puppet2d/V and scripts/character/puppet2d/V (the vector puppet that lost); art/character/puppet2d/P except work/mouth-ref-cfront.png, mouth-base-blank.png, mouth-mask2.png, rest.png (read by polish-r8, r9, r10 mouth scripts; scripts/character/puppet2d/P kept); scripts/character/polished; scripts/gpu/jobs/hello/runs (untracked, ignored by scripts/gpu/.gitignore). Last commit that holds all of them: 345b5f7c (git show 345b5f7c:<path>); each was last changed in ae880e84 (2026-11-06). .gitignore now lists the four kept P/work files as exceptions, so the tracked set and .gitignore agree. Kept on purpose: 3D head and Arjun, polish-r2 layers, polish-r8, r9, r10, lamp1, lamp2, route-b, prototypes/, src/face-puppet/adapter.tsx. Also removed: src/ui/teacher/useDelight.ts, unused prefetchLook/lookIds/faceRigFailed, the voiceOnly and gentle props of TutorFace/PuppetFace/LessonFace, the .tx-picker css. App's share of the dead code (getTutors, chooseTutor, SITE_TUTORS, TeacherPortrait) is docs/patches/to-app/008-face-dead-code.patch.

Daily greeting (FACE-07): a child never gets the same line two days running (server/face-puppet/greetings.js lineIndex: per-child offset, per-child step of 1..n-1 per day); six lines that claimed history ('pick up where we left off', 'Hi again', and their Hindi and Hinglish forms) were replaced by new ids *-m4 and *-a4 (each slot still has three lines; no clips were rendered, so no file names changed meaning); the greeting's day and Kaksha Home's greeting word both turn at 04:00 through shared/day.js (learningDay, partOfDay).
